finals.race: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £100,000 purchase after an Irish point win last March and showed plenty of ability when finding another expensive purchase from that sphere too good in a Southwell bumper in February. Rates a useful hurdling prospect for his in-form yard.

finals.race: KSR Lighting Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Dam maiden over jumps in France, from family of very smart staying chaser Virak. Promise when second of 8 in maiden bumper at Nancy last autumn. Changed hands for £100,000 after but he didn't look straightforward despite occupying same spot at Newton Abbot in April. Since left Paul Nicholls.

finals.race: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Likeable front runner who backed up his Newcastle success in March with an excellent third at Haydock (2m, good) in April. Ran one of his lesser races in the Swinton back at Haydock in May. Freshened up since and returns with Neil Mulholland among the winners.

finals.race: My Laces Cost More Than Your Shoes Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Steadily-progressive 6-y-o. Smooth-travelling second here in April. Again prominent in the market when going one better with an air of authority over C&D on return. Capable of defying a 5 lb rise under jockey enjoying purple patch - 8 wins at 29% strike rate (much higher than usual) in last 4 weeks.

finals.race: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Quirky veteran. Finished runner-up 4 times either side of small-field handicap success at Newton Abbot in June. Typically raced lazily (off an excessively strong gallop) when beaten 8½ lengths at Hereford latest. Again has his drawbacks as a betting proposition.

finals.race: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Course regular. Completed a double when notching a fifth victory here (2¾m) in September (form hasn't proved robust). Looked handicapped to the hilt when placing in consecutive C&D handicaps since, though does at least have match-fitness on his side.

finals.race: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Posted some strong form in novice hurdles in 2023/4. Since looked one with problems in handicap hurdles/chases, pulling hard on final start for Paul Nicholls last March. Questions to answer back hurdling for new yard following 20-month absence.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Shaped well several times this year before scoring in impressive fashion at York in September. Good fifth under penalty in strong 3-y-o race at Doncaster St Leger meeting just 4 days later. Well backed but withdrawn after getting upset in stalls on intended outing at York last month. Tapeta debut.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Dual course winner last year. Respectable seventh of 14 on C&D Good Friday reappearance. Has struggled on turf since but could fare better back on his favoured surface.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Hold-up type who won over C&D last year and capitalised on a career-low mark at Redcar (1¼m) in September. Good placed efforts on 2 of his 3 outings since and one of 2 with a shout for Tim Easterby.

finals.race: carpetgallop.co.uk Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €10,000 3-y-o, Valirann gelding. Half-brother to fair hurdler Armed And Fabulous, stays 3m. Jockey bookings suggest Lipati is the stable's main hope.

finals.race: carpetgallop.co.uk Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: €35,000 3-y-o, £20,000 4-y-o, Choeur Du Nord gelding. Dam maiden half-sister to fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stays 21f) Yccs Portocervo. Third of 4 finishers on his sole outing in points.

finals.race: BetMGM Handicap Chase (Premier Handicap) (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Very useful chaser who landed handicap at Cheltenham (27f) last November and posted a respectable second in 4-runner Rowland Meyrick at Wetherby over Christmas. Off 6 months, solid third on Flat at Pontefract (2¼m, heavy) 18 days ago. Not out of things back in this sphere.

finals.race: Weddings At Fontwell Park Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Hadn't shown much on the Flat for this yard but upped his game fitted with a visor, taking another step forward when running out a dominant winner over 19f here last month despite a late blunder. Again made a few mistakes when third at Southwell but these regulation obstacles may suit better.

finals.race: Weddings At Fontwell Park Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Promise in a Huntingdon bumper and offered something to work on when third of 6 in juvenile at Haydock on hurdling debut in December. Well below that level next 2 starts but shaped well until making mistake on reappearance/handicap debut at Southwell 3 weeks ago. Hood goes on and he's of interest.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Hasn't shown much so far and starts out in handicaps from a mark which demands improvement.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Nursery
finals.comment: Shaped well when third in 6f Ripon maiden on debut but has failed to build on it 3 times since. Handicap debut.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Nursery
finals.comment: Improvement when getting off the mark upped to 7f at Musselburgh in September when fitted with a first-time hood. Now steps up even further in trip and a 4 lb rise in the weights shouldn't prevent him going well on all-weather debut.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Modest form on balance in 3 starts to date and needs a step forward for this longer trip/all-weather debut.

finals.race: AW Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd Jan 2027 EBF Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fourth of 8 in a novice at Beverley in September on debut, showing a bit though looks likely to be suited by further than this 7f.

finals.race: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Handicap
finals.comment: Low-mileage 3-y-o from a good yard. Runner-up on 3 of her first 4 starts. Well treated on that form but well below par at Yarmouth last time. Interesting if first-time blinkers have the desired effect.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
finals.comment: Bounced back to form in a first-time visor when successful at Southwell (1m) 6 days ago, ridden out to score by ½ length from Archangel Josepi. Only fifth start for an excellent yard and should go well again under a 5-lb penalty.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting 'Acca Boost' Apprentice Handicap
finals.comment: Deservedly got off the mark over C&D in January. Lightly raced on turf since and ridden too aggressively when fourteenth of 15 in handicap at Listowel last time. No surprise to see him bounce back returned here.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Landed Naas conditions event and listed race at Cork (both over 7f) this summer. Took another step forward with an excellent fourth of 18 in handicap at Leopardstown (1m, good to firm) last time, nearest finish having been forced wide. Very much one to consider  polytrack debut.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Useful filly. Well-beaten last of 12 to Radiant Beauty in listed race at Pontefract (1m, good) in July on her final run for Ed Walker. Needs this yard switch to spark a resurgence.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Fairly useful filly. Got off the mark at the eleventh attempt in 5-runner maiden at Bellewstown (1m, soft) 36 days ago. Makes polytrack debut with lots to find on form.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Useful filly.Posted a career best when readily winning 12-runner handicap at Fairyhouse (7f, good) in September. This course winner can make her presence felt.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Cooley Fillies Stakes (Fillies' And Mares' Listed)
finals.comment: Fairly useful mare. Got off the mark for the season in 5-runner handicap here (7f) 35 days ago by ¾ length from Aviatrice, though very much had the run of the race. This demands more. RESERVE

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
finals.comment: €30,000 foal. Naval Crown colt. Offered something to work on when sixth of 18 in maiden at Naas (1m, soft, 20/1) on debut 27 days ago. Should have more to offer for yard whose juveniles tend to come on for the outing.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting '2Up Early Payout' Handicap
finals.comment: C&D winner has proved a model of consistency since scoring at Leopardstown (9f) in June. Has been holding his form well since, only just failing to reel in the winner when second of 14 in handicap at this C&D 7 days ago. Shortlist material.

finals.race: BAR 1 Betting Bet Builder Boost Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Gained a breakthrough success in first-time cheekpieces at Bellewstown in August. Has made the frame 2 of 3 starts since (had excuses on the other occasion) and the headgear left off the last twice is now back on. Enters calculations.
